rationale: Wayback CDX is a durable standalone recovery/time-series channel for deleted BSI and Bankart statistics pages.
Single 2021 hackathon press release; useful evidence of NLB open-banking priorities, not a recurring feed (monitor the NLB media centre instead).
National startup-ecosystem portal that keeps producing bank/fintech challenge announcements; standalone pointer feed.
DSI per-year programme subdomains are a recurring agenda archive where banks and Bankart present implementation detail.
Commercial event calendar with weak payments specificity; recheck value against dpc.delo.si before monitoring.
Halcom vendor news is a genuine supplier-side feed on bank go-lives, but the .ba URL failed verification — confirm the correct halcom.si/eu path first.
One-off mirrored Bankart recruitment deck; harvest the figures once, the host produces no further signals.
Bankart docs section sits on a domain already monitored (7 siblings); track versioned PDF uploads under the parent bankart.si watch.
Sub-page of bsi.si (39 siblings) with little standalone output; covered by regulator-site monitoring.
A single Svet kapitala article on a partly paywalled outlet; delo.si tag pages are the monitorable parent.
SiStat PxWeb is the master machine-readable denominator database with an API — core standalone source for this cell.
API documentation to mine once when building the SiStat collector; not a signal-producing feed.
Annual ICT household survey is the only official SI read on online payment method (card vs cash on delivery vs transfer).
Enterprise ICT/online-sales survey supplies the merchant-acceptance and card-not-present denominator; recurring releases.
Monthly retail turnover is the core denominator for POS value, card penetration and seasonality; regular machine-readable updates.
URL is a single DocSysFile methodology/results document; keep as evidence and monitor the APG programme page/SiStat tables instead.
COICOP household final consumption table (0301941S), 1995 onward, machine-readable — durable series for sizing addressable payment value.
EU-SILC gives income distribution and financial-exclusion segmentation for cash-dependence analysis; recurring annual releases.
Release calendar lets collectors be scheduled deterministically; continuously refreshed standalone feed.
English mirror of the same StatWeb site already covered by the SURS/SiStat entries; language variant, not a separate source.
Microdata (safe room / remote access) requires ORA committee approval — valuable but a human must clear access.
OPSI CKAN catalogue is a durable, licence-clear discovery and alternative-access layer for SURS/AJPES/FURS datasets.
JOLP gives audited firm-level accounts for banks, PSPs and acquirers but is registration-gated with a 20-subjects/day cap — access and terms must be cleared.
Twice-monthly open bulk XML business register; entity backbone for NACE-filtered merchant and PSP universes.
Agency portal / information catalogue to mine once for further AJPES registers; the specific registers are the monitored sources.
UMAR Ekonomsko ogledalo is a recurring monthly analytical publication interpreting retail and consumption data; useful sense-check layer.
FURS fiscalisation is the highest-resolution national till-volume proxy; monitor for aggregate publications, noting card is folded into 'cash' by law.
